subject: planner:  Support the behavior when combine the order_index + partial order (#66181)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff: planner change is limited to `skylinePruning` so forced access paths with `NO_ORDER_INDEX` (`ForceNoKeepOrder=true`) no longer set `ForcePartialOrder`, preventing partial-order TopN enumeration from incorrectly forbidding normal (non-keep-order) plans and triggering “Can't find a proper physical plan” failures. Added integration cases cover ORDER_INDEX/NO_ORDER_INDEX interactions with `tidb_opt_partial_ordered_index_for_topn`. No Blocker/High issues found; upstream/master shows no follow-up changes to this block.
